notes.title: Military, Elite Housing, Desirability, Music
notes.content:
[h3][b]New tutorial missions[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Elite Housing
[*] Military
[/list]

[h3][b]New scenario category[/b][/h3]
"Military" with following missions:
[list]
[*] Trade Route
[*] Invasion
[*] Greenlands
[*] Great Pyramid
[/list]

[h3][b]Elite Houses[/b][/h3]
Elite Houses can be placed the same way as regular houses, however, they occupy 3x3 tiles instead of 2x2. 

Elite Houses require all the resources that a maximum level of the regular house requires, plus extra ones and a desirability level. (right-click over the elite house to see what it requires currently)

Elite Houses will be required to complete missions in future campaigns.

[h3][b]Military[/b][/h3]
You can now build walls, gates, and towers, which require stone to be constructed. You can place swordsmen and archer's legions. A Recruiter building is required to train military units.

This is the base for the military aspect of the game, it will be worked on, improved and more features will be added in the future, including water transportation and combat.

[h3][b]New resources[/b][/h3]
A new production chain has been added. 

[i]Iron Mine -> Iron -> Weaponsmith -> Weapons[/i]

Weaponsmith is located under the "Military" category.

[h3][b]Desirability[/b][/h3]
Desirability has been added. Some buildings now decrease the desirability of the surrounding area while beautification buildings increase it.

Right now, only Elite Houses require desirability.

[h3][b]Disease risk[/b][/h3]

Remember to place apothecaries next to houses. Houses will be burned to prevent the disease from spreading. (If you are loading your old save files, it might be a good idea to immediately pause the game when the level loads and then place apothecaries everywhere)

[h3][b]New music[/b][/h3]
Seven new tracks have been adding to the game. The soundtrack is close to being one hour long right now. Music will change to battle themed when enemy armies invade.

[h3][b]Fixes and changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The camera has been fixed and should act in the same way for everyone now. If you can't move the camera or it moves too fast, change camera speed in settings.
[*] It is now possible to pause the game by pressing the spacebar.
[*] The risk display has been slightly reworked.
[*] The main menu will load much faster now when quitting from the map.
[*] Fixed a bug where resources would not be delivered to pyramids.
[*] Fixed some bugs that were causing crashes.
[*] Fixed a bug where some processes were not terminating properly, causing steam to display the game as playing after quitting it.
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfix #2
notes.content:
Fixed crash when loading the game that was happening on some machines.

I have removed the campaign map "Sandbox" in the "Monuments" category which also seemed to crash the game for some players.

This is far from a perfect solution and I will work on fixing this properly in upcoming updates, however, I want to make sure that the game launches at all for everyone.

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Monuments and land trade update
notes.content:
[b]I am happy to announce that monument construction and land trade have now been added to the game.[/b]

[b]Currently available monuments are:[/b]
[list]
[*] small/medium/big plain stone pyramid (requires the stone to be constructed)
[*] small/medium/big limestone pyramid (requires stone and limestone to be constructed)
[*] small/medium/big smooth pyramid (requires stone and limestone to be constructed)
[*] mastaba (requires bricks to be constructed)
[*] obelisk (requires granite and wood to be constructed)
[/list]

[b]New resource:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bricks
[/list]

[b]New production building:[/b]
[list]
[*] Brickmaker (requires clay to produce bricks)
[/list]

[b]New tutorial mission:[/b]
[list]
[*] Monuments
[/list]

[b]New scenarios category:[/b]
[list]
[*] Monuments
[/list]

[b]New maps:[/b] (in Monuments category)
[list]
[*] Dahshur
[*] Saqqara
[*] Giza
[*] Sandbox
[/list]

[b]Note on the new "Sandbox" map:[/b]
It is the first time that I introduce an enormous map. (1024x1024 tiles)

The loading times might be slower on older machines. 
If immigrants are not coming to houses, consider placing bridges to open more paths.

If you encounter any issues with the map I would greatly appreciate it if you could describe them on Steam forums or Discord.

[b]New unit:[/b]
[list]
[*] Land Trader
[/list]

[b]Land trade has now been added. [/b]
Every other month a trader will enter the city if you have any resources in warehouses that he can buy or sell.


[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] If the game crashes, instead of silently shutting down it will display a window with an error message. (I will greatly appreciate it if you share it with me on Steam forums, Discord, or through support email.

[*] It is now possible to zoom in and out by using the middle mouse button.

[*] Slightly reworked how the building name and price are being displayed in the construction bar.

[*] Yearly income pop-up was removed. You can still view the reports as usual and a small notification on the top of the screen will appear. (I found it to be more annoying than useful)

[*] Notification will now show when your city does not have enough workers.

[*] Decreased "No working dock" notification display rate.

[*] Minimap will now reappear when closing the in-game menu.

[*] Fixed graphical bug where the white lines were appearing over water on the furthest zoom.

[*] Tutorial progress is now saved correctly when saving the tutorial map.
[/list]

Remember that I am here to resolve any issues that you might have with the game.

[b]Enjoy the new content![/b]
